# McGill University
> McGill University is a leading Canadian research university offering academic programs, research, libraries, student services, and institutional information.

McGill’s website spans admissions, academics, research, libraries, student life, and administrative services across undergraduate, graduate, and professional education in Montréal.

## Main University
- [McGill University Home](https://www.mcgill.ca/): Main university portal with access to academics, admissions, research, and campus services.
- [About McGill](https://www.mcgill.ca/about): Overview of McGill’s history, mission, leadership, and institutional profile.
- [Faculties and Schools](https://www.mcgill.ca/faculties): Directory of McGill faculties, schools, and academic units.
- [Maps and Directions](https://www.mcgill.ca/maps): Campus maps, building locations, and transportation information.
- [Contact McGill](https://www.mcgill.ca/contact-us): Central contact information and ways to reach university offices.
- [Newsroom](https://www.mcgill.ca/newsroom): University news, announcements, and institutional updates.

## Admissions
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions): Undergraduate application requirements, deadlines, and admissions guidance.
- [Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies](https://www.mcgill.ca/gps): Graduate admissions, programs, policies, and student resources.
- [Continuing Studies](https://www.mcgill.ca/continuingstudies): Certificates, diplomas, and professional development programs for lifelong learners.
- [International Student Services](https://www.mcgill.ca/internationalstudents): Immigration, arrival, and support resources for international students.
- [Scholarships and Student Aid](https://www.mcgill.ca/studentaid): Financial aid, scholarships, bursaries, and funding information.

## Academics
- [Programs, Courses and University Regulations](https://www.mcgill.ca/study): Official academic calendar with programs, courses, and regulations.
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/programs): Browse undergraduate degrees, majors, and academic options.
- [Graduate Programs](https://www.mcgill.ca/gps/programs): Explore graduate degrees, diplomas, and postdoctoral opportunities.
- [Class Schedule](https://www.mcgill.ca/study/2024-2025/): Academic year calendars, course listings, and program requirements.
- [Teaching and Learning Services](https://www.mcgill.ca/tls): Support for teaching, learning, course design, and educational development.

## Research
- [Research and Innovation](https://www.mcgill.ca/research): Research priorities, funding support, ethics, and innovation resources.
- [Office of Sponsored Research](https://www.mcgill.ca/research/researchers/office-sponsored-research): Research administration, grants, and contract support.
- [Research Ethics and Compliance](https://www.mcgill.ca/research/researchers/compliance): Ethics review, compliance requirements, and oversight information.
- [Libraries](https://www.mcgill.ca/library): Library services, collections, research help, and access tools.
- [eScholarship at McGill](https://www.mcgill.ca/library/services/open-access/es): Open access support and institutional repository services.

## Libraries and Collections
- [McGill University Library](https://www.mcgill.ca/library): Library homepage with services, collections, and research support.
- [Library Hours](https://www.mcgill.ca/library/branches/hours): Opening hours for library branches and service points.
- [Find Subject Guides](https://libraryguides.mcgill.ca/): Subject and course guides for research across disciplines.
- [WorldCat Discovery](https://mcgill.on.worldcat.org/discovery): Search books, articles, journals, and library holdings.
- [Rare Books and Special Collections](https://www.mcgill.ca/library/branches/rbsc): Special collections, archives, and rare materials.
- [Open Access and Scholarly Communications](https://www.mcgill.ca/library/services/open-access): Open access publishing and scholarly communication support.
- [Interlibrary Loan](https://www.mcgill.ca/library/services/ill): Borrow materials from other libraries and institutions.

## Student Services
- [Student Services](https://www.mcgill.ca/studentservices): Central hub for health, wellness, advising, and campus support.
- [Service Point](https://www.mcgill.ca/servicepoint): Front-line student administrative services and records support.
- [Career Planning Service](https://www.mcgill.ca/caps): Career advising, workshops, and job search resources.
- [Student Wellness Hub](https://www.mcgill.ca/wellness-hub): Health, mental health, and wellness services for students.
- [First-Year Office](https://www.mcgill.ca/firstyear): Transition support and resources for new undergraduate students.
- [Accessibility Services](https://www.mcgill.ca/access-achieve): Academic accommodations and accessibility support.

## Campus Life
- [Student Housing and Hospitality Services](https://www.mcgill.ca/students/housing): Residences, housing options, and move-in information.
- [Athletics and Recreation](https://www.mcgill.ca/athletics): Varsity sports, recreation programs, and fitness facilities.
- [Dean of Students](https://www.mcgill.ca/deanofstudents): Student engagement, support, and campus life initiatives.
- [Student Societies](https://www.mcgill.ca/students/srr): Information about student representation and campus involvement.
- [Food and Dining](https://www.mcgill.ca/foodservices): Campus dining locations, meal plans, and food services.
- [Campus Safety](https://www.mcgill.ca/campussafety): Emergency preparedness, security, and safety resources.

## IT and Digital Services
- [McGill IT Services](https://www.mcgill.ca/it): IT support, accounts, software, and digital services.
- [Minerva](https://horizon.mcgill.ca/pban1/twbkwbis.P_WWWLogin): Student information system for registration, records, and account tasks.
- [myCourses](https://mycourses2.mcgill.ca/): Learning management system for courses and class materials.
- [VPN Service](https://www.mcgill.ca/it/services/network/vpn): Secure remote access to McGill network resources.
- [Email and Office 365](https://www.mcgill.ca/it/services/email): University email services and account guidance.
- [Software Licensing](https://www.mcgill.ca/it/services/software): Available software, downloads, and licensing information.

## Governance and Administration
- [Principal and Vice-Chancellor](https://www.mcgill.ca/principal): Office of the principal and institutional leadership information.
- [Board of Governors](https://www.mcgill.ca/boardofgovernors): Governance, membership, meetings, and board documentation.
- [Senate](https://www.mcgill.ca/senate): Academic governance, agendas, minutes, and senate information.
- [Human Resources](https://www.mcgill.ca/hr): Employment, benefits, policies, and staff resources.
- [Procurement Services](https://www.mcgill.ca/procurement): Purchasing policies, supplier information, and procurement support.
- [Equity Team](https://www.mcgill.ca/equity): Equity, diversity, and inclusion policies and resources.

## Alumni and Giving
- [McGill Alumni](https://www.mcgill.ca/alumni): Alumni benefits, events, networking, and community engagement.
- [Giving to McGill](https://www.mcgill.ca/giving): Donation opportunities, campaigns, and philanthropic priorities.
- [Advancement and Alumni Relations](https://www.mcgill.ca/advancement): University advancement initiatives and alumni engagement.
- [McGill24](https://www.mcgill.ca/giving/mcgill24): Annual day of giving and community fundraising campaign.

## News and Publications
- [McGill Reporter](https://reporter.mcgill.ca/): University publication covering campus news, research, and community stories.
- [Channels](https://www.mcgill.ca/channels): Video stories, lectures, and multimedia content from McGill.
- [Newsroom](https://www.mcgill.ca/newsroom): Official news releases and media resources.
- [Events at McGill](https://www.mcgill.ca/channels/section/events): University events, lectures, and public programming.
